name: comp-448
blurb: Breadcrumb with home icon in first position.
description: Breadcrumb navigation with home icon replacing text in the first/root item.
use_when: File systems or navigation where home is the root, using icon instead of text.
avoid_when: Text-based breadcrumbs requiring explicit labels throughout.
a11y: Semantic breadcrumb with home icon; needs proper aria-label on icon link.
